messages:
emma_cs: Quick heads-up — embeddings routing incident has impacted ~120 tenants in eu-west; we need outbound comms to affected customers today. Draft below. Need owners for: (1) targeted email, (2) live Q&A office hours, (3) exec summary. ETA for RCA timeline by EOD. @raj_ops @miguel_eng

raj_ops: On it. Prioritize customers with >$50k ARR. Also can someone draft a 1-paragraph exec summary? I’ll pull the list by EOD.

miguel_eng: Root cause so far: a config rollback during a deploy reverted the routing weight table for embedding requests. We pinned the previous config and pushed a canary; traffic now stable. Collecting timeline + logs for RCA.

emma_cs: Draft email (short):
Hi <Customer>,

We experienced an intermittent routing issue earlier today that affected embeddings requests. The issue is mitigated; some requests saw higher latency or 5xx errors between 09:12–09:47 UTC. We're investigating the root cause and will follow up with an RCA and credits where applicable. We're scheduling a live Q&A for impacted customers to answer questions.

Immediate ask: reply to this email if you'd like to join the live session or need a one-on-one runthrough.

Sincerely — Emma, Customer Success

sara_pm: Recommend offering 2 weeks of service credit for high-touch tenants and 1 week for others + a free enablement session. I can approve.

emma_cs: Proposed live Q&A: Thu 16:00 UTC, 30m. Link: https://meet.redwood/rca-qa. Agenda: timeline, mitigation, next steps, live Q&A.

raj_ops: I'll own the targeted send list + segmentation for high-touch tenants. @sales_ops please prep a brief outreach template with renewal sensitivity language.

sales_ops: Got it, will prep template and coordinate with renewals. ETA: 2 hours.

miguel_eng: Quick log excerpt for timeline:
```
09:11:45 deploy-trigger: start
09:12:02 config-rollback: routing_weights reverted
09:12:18 embed-service: 503 spikes
09:47:30 canary-success: traffic normalized
```

emma_cs: Nice, Miguel — can you also attach the full timeline to the email thread before send?

miguel_eng: Will attach full timeline + incident ticket link by EOD.

incidentbot: [incident-bot] Incident mitigated and marked for postmortem. Actions: create postmortem doc, add an alert for routing weight drift, run a canary on next deploy.

emma_cs: Next steps:
- raj_ops: targeted sends + exec summary
- miguel_eng: full timeline + RCA draft
- sara_pm: approve credits + confirm enablement offer
- sales_ops: outreach template

If anyone can't make Thu slot, flag it here. Otherwise I’ll send the targeted emails after Raj finalizes the list (~EOD).
